.claude/settings.json: Not a plugin. One SessionStart hook for agent sessions opened in this repo, running scripts/session_setup.py. In a cloud session only, and only when the commit email is not already a GitHub noreply address, it sets user.name and user.email in this clone's own .git/config to the owner's public noreply identity, so check.py --history passes. It reads no files, sends nothing, prints nothing and always exits 0, so it cannot block a session. Tested in scripts/test_session_setup.py.
plugins/claude-code-context-advisor/skil: advise.py uses the Python standard library only. It reads one Claude Code session record, chosen by the person or the newest for the current folder, and prints a report of names, counts, sizes and the first 60 characters of a shell command, never file contents. It writes nothing and runs no commands. Tested in scripts/test_advise.py.
plugins/claude-code-guards/hooks: Registers four PreToolUse hooks that only answer ask, deny or nothing, and one PostToolUse hook that only adds a warning beside a web or connector result. None edits files or results, sends data or allows a call the person's settings would block. A failing PreToolUse guard asks rather than allowing.
plugins/claude-code-guards/scripts: Python standard library only. Reads the hook input and, for pushes, runs read-only git commands (remote get-url, rev-parse, symbolic-ref, log). Writes only an empty per-session marker in the system temp folder. The connector guard skips servers the person lists in the overlay's trusted_servers (empty by default); no server is trusted in code. Tested in scripts/test_guards.py.
plugins/claude-code-session-meter/hooks: Registers one UserPromptSubmit hook that only warns, or holds one prompt per limit when the person turns hard_stop on, and one Stop hook that only shows a reminder line and never blocks. A failing hook stays silent, so it can never block the person. Neither sends anything or changes a file of theirs.
plugins/claude-code-session-meter/script: Python standard library only. statusline.py runs read-only git commands (rev-parse, rev-list, status) with a 1 second timeout and reads the plugin list and guards overlay. handoff_nudge.py reads the session transcript to count edits. All scripts write only small JSON files named by a hash of the session id in the system temp folder. Tested in scripts/test_meter.py.
plugins/private-words/skills/private-wor: scan.py reads the user's list, the repo and its Git log. Its only write is gh secret set, on request, by standard input. It prints no word.
plugins/read-only-researcher/agents: One subagent limited to Read, Grep, Glob, WebSearch and WebFetch, with Bash, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Agent disallowed, so it cannot change files, run commands or delegate.
scripts/autoupdate.py: Not a plugin, but it installs and updates plugins without a person present, so it is recorded here. It runs only when a person turns it on with --install-launchd, and they choose to trust this repo's plugins when they do. Python standard library only. It runs git ls-remote and claude plugin marketplace add/update, list, install and update, and only for the skillknot marketplace, with no shell, so nothing from GitHub becomes a command. It removes nothing and leaves other plugins and settings alone. It never installs or updates a plugin with hooks, so a change that can steer sessions waits for a person. The job runs a copy made at install time, so a push cannot change the code that runs. The new plugins it installs still pass Claude Code's own install checks, which refuse a command-source install here because no person can confirm it. It writes only its log, its last-commit file, that copy and one LaunchAgent file. Tested in scripts/test_autoupdate.py.
